name: Aina
source:
A genius engineer of the Union. 
She was the one who invented the underground shelter Neosphere, the AI caretaker Cradle, and the fighting robot Tierblade.

She has been in a long term relationship with [url=/c49385]Gill[/url], and is like a mother and older sister to [url=/c48839]Eve[/url].
